subject: Insurance
title: The Core Promise
description: Learn The Core Promise in one minute.

hook.text: Life insurance makes a simple deal: you pay small amounts while alive, and your family gets a large sum when you die.

buildup.text: Without it, a breadwinner's death can bankrupt a family overnight.

discovery.text: The policy replaces lost income. A $500,000 policy costs about $30 per month for a healthy 30-year-old. Cheap certainty.

climax.text: Life insurance isn't about you—it's about everyone who depends on you. The payout funds the life you can't be there for.

punchline.text: $30 a month, $500,000 at death. Life insurance protects the living.

quiz.question: What does life insurance primarily protect?
